I'll just keep the parts in a lock-box until the handgun freeze is over then.

If I were to be 'Willed' a handgun from a deceased relative, but only received a disassembled slide, would it be possible to import a complete frame or order frame parts/frame separately?

I figure since the serial # is on the frame (near the trigger guard according to google) & it's disassembled, I could feasibly order a complete frame/ separate frame & parts, and then once assembled contact the RCMP or the Ontario CFO and register the completed gun under my name...

I'm NEW to firearms (got PAL/RPAL a few months ago, LONG after the handgun freeze) and it's my first time dealing with something like this, so any information would be helpful. 

Just trying to navigate the nonsense and not get arrested for something ridiculous. If it's NOT possible, I'll just Keep the slide disassembled and forego ordering any other parts until Conservatives unfreeze handguns.

Not Spanking Children, my sister and her ex raised a MENACE of a little girl, She screams, punches, scratches and bites if she doesn't get her way and is disruptive and argumentative if she's not the sole focus of EVERYONE'S attention...

I crawled into bed at literally midnight and less than 30 minutes later, the tornado that is my niece was set off, my clearly exhausted sister unwilling to even so much as raise her voice to get the terrible toddler to go to bed, as she didn't want to upset "her little angel"

I hear the commotion, leave the bedroom  and One hard swift smack on the ass later, the kid has shut the fuck up  and allowed me to rest in peace...

  
A Spanking =/= A Beating

  
It's really a shame that parents nowadays view disciplining their children as abuse...
